verifications.claim: Artemis II launched successfully on April 1, 2026, at 22:35:12 UTC (6:35:12 p.m. EDT) from Launch Complex 39B at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'Launch date April 1, 2026, 22:35:12 UTC (6:35:12 p.m. EDT)[5] Rocket Space Launch System Launch site Kennedy, LC-39B[6]'; R1: 'Launched from Florida on April 1'; R2/R3/R5 confirm April 1 from Kennedy/Florida.
verifications.reasoning: Exact match in R4 for date, time, and location; supported by all sources.

verifications.claim: Artemis II carried four astronauts aboard the Orion spacecraft.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'crew of four'; R2: 'four Artemis 2 astronauts'; R4: 'Crew size 4 Members Reid Wiseman Victor Glover Christina Koch Jeremy Hansen... aboard Orion'; all confirm four on Orion.
verifications.reasoning: All sources explicitly state four astronauts flew on Orion spacecraft.

verifications.claim: Artemis II's journey was a 10-day, 865,000-mile journey around the Moon.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R4: 'Mission duration 9 days, 1 hour, 32 minutes... Distance travelled 700,237 mi (1,126,922 km)'; R1/R2/R3: 'nearly 10-day' or '10-day mission' but max distance 252,756 miles, no 865,000 miles mentioned.
verifications.reasoning: Duration vaguely supported as ~10 days, but specific 865,000-mile distance contradicted by R4's total 700,237 miles; no source matches 865k miles.

verifications.claim: Artemis II splashed down on April 10, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'screengrab... April 10, 2026'; R2: 'splashdown... April 10, 8:07 p.m. EDT'; R3: 'splashed down... April 10'; R4: 'Landing date April 11, 2026... (April 10, 5:07:27 p.m. PDT)'; R5: 'splashdown April 10, 2026'.
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm splashdown on April 10 local US time (PDT/EDT), matching claim.

verifications.claim: The rocket for Artemis II was the Space Launch System (SLS).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'Rocket Space Launch System'; R2: 'NASA's Artemis 2 moon mission... Space Launch System'; R5: 'SLS (Space Launch System) rocket'.
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state SLS was the rocket used.

verifications.claim: The crew of Artemis II was Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Commander Reid Wiseman, pilot Victor Glover, Christina Koch and Canada's Jeremy Hansen'; R2/R4: exact names listed; R5: crew photo/names match.
verifications.reasoning: All sources list exactly these four as the crew.

verifications.claim: Artemis II's mission goal was the first crewed flyby of the Moon in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'first lunar voyage in more than a half-century... lunar flyby'; R4: 'first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit since Apollo 17 in 1972... Crewed lunar flyby'; R5: 'NASA’s First Crewed Lunar Flyby in 50 Years'; all confirm first since Apollo 17 (~54 years).
verifications.reasoning: All sources describe it as first crewed lunar mission/flyby since Apollo 17 in 1972, over 50 years.
